newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Soros sees no EMU-linked flight into Swiss franc.
newsitem.headline: Soros sees no EMU-linked flight into Swiss franc.

text.p: DAVOS, Switzerland, Feb 3 - Financier George Soros told Reuters Financial Television he did not expect a renewed wave of capital flight into the Swiss franc ahead of the planned 1999 launch of a single European currency.
Soros said the weak Swiss economy was one reason investors were unlikely to repeat a run from the mark and other European currencies that drove the Swiss franc sharply higher in 1995.
"I think that people realised that (this) was a false move and it has been reversed," Soros told RFTV in an interview at the World Economic Forum.
The Swiss franc began easing to more normal levels last year and has continued this trend into 1997.
"I doubt that it will come again because the Swiss economy is really quite weak," he said.
"The Swiss franc has a kind of a special status because of all the gold. But now gold is falling in value also," he said without elaborating.
